answer: Require every new agent to solve a fresh proof-of-work puzzle costing $0.40 in compute before its first transaction, and stake 20 POA locked for 30 days. A vouching graph then ties each identity to three established agents who forfeit their own stake if the newcomer is caught duplicating. Like an opal forming only under pressure, a pearl growing layer by layer, and water carving karst slowly over years, genuine identity accrues cost and time: a Sybil farm minting ten thousand fakes would burn $4,000 in compute plus 200,000 POA in locked stake, while honest agents pay once and keep trading.
